meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Intelligent refactor command. Triggers: refactor, refactoring, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构代码结构，消除坏味道，提升可维护性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码变得难以维护，需要系统性地改善结构
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code, eliminate bad smells, and improve maintainability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has become hard to maintain and needs systematic structural improvement

howto.what: 指定要重构的代码(文件、符号、模式等)后,Claude 会先确认目标和范围,再并行探索代码、构建依赖图、评估测试覆盖,制定计划,逐步修改并每步跑测试,最后全量验证并总结。
howto.when: 当你输入 /refactor 命令,或说出 “refactor”“cleanup”“restructure” 等触发词,请求重构代码时触发。

say.text: 把 src/auth/handler.ts 里的校验逻辑提取成独立模块。
say.note: Claude 会先分析依赖和测试,再逐步改动。

say.text: 用安全策略重构 AuthService 类,范围限定 module。
say.note: 它会先制定计划,再按步执行并验证。

say.text: 清理所有调用废弃 API 的函数,并保持测试通过。
say.note: 若测试覆盖不足,它会停下来问你是否先补测试。

howto.what_en: Claude confirms goals, explores related code, maps dependencies, checks test coverage, plans, edits step by step running tests after each change, then does a final verification and summary.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you enter the /refactor command or say trigger words like "refactor", "cleanup", "restructure", etc., to request a code refactor.

say_en.text: Extract the validation logic in src/auth/handler.ts into a separate module.
say_en.note: It analyzes dependencies and tests first, then edits.

say_en.text: Refactor the AuthService class with safe strategy, scope module.
say_en.note: Plans first, then executes step by step with verification.

say_en.text: Clean up all functions calling the deprecated API while keeping tests green.
say_en.note: If coverage is low, it stops and asks about adding tests.
